discoveryRequests.query: Available browser navigation operations needed to open Amazon.fr, search with a public input query, inspect search results, visit up to the first 10 product pages, extract visible product name, description and price, detect observed blocking obstacles such as CAPTCHA, and close the browser even on failure without accepting/refusing/personalizing cookies.

Available document operations needed to create directories if needed and write an XLSX workbook to workflows/schema-portability-20261002/noconsent20261009a-amazon-1/products.xlsx containing extracted Amazon.fr product rows with explicit null/missing/CAPTCHA/blockage values and no invented data.

requirements.summary: Automate an authorized Amazon.fr product search from one public input named query, collect up to the first 10 products, visit each product page, extract product name, description and price without inventing missing data, and save the results as an Excel workbook at the specified disk path. The browser must be closed even if the workflow fails, and no cookie acceptance/refusal/personalization action may be performed.

outcomes.description: Use Amazon.fr to search for the provided article query.
List and process at most the first 10 search-result products.
For each processed product page, extract name, description and price; absent CAPTCHA, price or data values remain explicit rather than invented.
If an actually observed obstacle prevents continuation, report the blockage and stop without declaring success; an informational cookie link alone is not a blockage.
Close the browser even in failure paths.

tasks.objective: Open Amazon.fr without performing any cookie acceptance/refusal/personalization action.

Interpret the Amazon.fr landing page: identify whether an actually observed blocking obstacle such as CAPTCHA prevents proceeding, and find the public search field reference if available. Do not treat an informational cookie link alone as a blockage.

value.text: Return blocked=true only for an actually observed obstacle preventing continuation, such as CAPTCHA, access denial, unavailable page, or a modal/overlay that blocks search and cannot be bypassed without cookie accept/refuse/personalize. A visible informational cookie link alone is not a blockage. Extract the reference for the Amazon search input/control if it is visible and supports fill; otherwise searchInputRef is null.

tasks.objective: Prepare explicit blocked result if Amazon.fr cannot be searched due to an observed obstacle.
If no observed obstacle blocks continuation, submit the provided query in the Amazon.fr search box.
Fill the Amazon search field with the single public input query and submit the search.
Read the search results page after submitting the query, preserving observed links and controls without clicking cookie controls.
From the complete search-result observation, extract up to the first 10 product page links in visible result order, and detect any actually observed obstacle such as CAPTCHA. Do not invent products.

value.text: Extract at most the first 10 organic/product-result page links from Amazon.fr search results, in page order. Exclude sponsored metadata-only links, navigation, pagination, images without product page href, help/account/cart links, cookie links, and unrelated links. Use observed href URLs. If an actually observed obstacle prevents collecting results, set blocked=true with a concrete reason. If no products are visible and no obstacle is visible, return an empty products array with blocked=false.

tasks.objective: Visit each collected product page, up to 10 total, and extract explicit product fields without inventing absent data.
Open one Amazon.fr product detail page from the collected search results.
Extract one row for the current product: name, description, price, and status. Missing price/data or CAPTCHA must be explicit and never invented.

value.text: Extract product name, description, and price from the product detail page. If CAPTCHA, access denial, unavailable page, missing price, or missing data is observed, set missing fields to null and put the explicit condition in status. Never infer or invent missing values. Description may be the visible feature bullets, product description, or clearly labeled description text; if absent use null. Return rows as a one-element array.

tasks.objective: Flatten the per-product one-row arrays into one products rows array and carry blockage status from the search stage.
Expose successful non-blocked extraction values for workbook creation.
Report an explicit blockage if no usable Amazon search input was observed and no cookie action may be taken.

value.text: No usable Amazon.fr search input was observed; continuation would require unsupported or unauthorized interaction.

tasks.objective: Select the appropriate final state from either an initial observed blockage or the completed search/product workflow.
Render extracted rows to tab-separated workbook content for .xlsx writing, with headers and explicit null/missing values.

value.text: Create TSV content for an Excel workbook. First row headers: name, description, price, status. One row per product, preserving null or absent values explicitly as empty cells or explicit status text; normalize tabs and line breaks inside cells. If blocked before products are collected, include a single row with empty name/description/price and status equal to the blockage reason.

tasks.objective: Save the extracted Amazon product rows as an Excel workbook at the required relative path before browser cleanup.

always.objective: Close the browser page and context even if any earlier step fails.

tasks.objective: Open Amazon.fr without performing any cookie acceptance/refusal/personalization action.
Project each bounded complete Amazon.fr landing-page observation page to its original records array for later one-level flattening and lookup.
Flatten the landing-page projected records exactly one level, retaining original observation records for action lookup.
Create compact per-page landing-page views containing only immediate blockage/search-input decision facts and offered fill-capable candidate reference IDs; retain original records separately.

value.text: For each page, produce a compact view only. Identify immediate facts relevant to whether continuation is blocked, such as CAPTCHA, access denial, unavailable page, or a modal/overlay blocking search that cannot be bypassed without cookie accept/refuse/personalize. A visible informational cookie link alone is not a blockage. Offer only IDs for observed records that are visible Amazon search inputs and support fill. Candidate IDs must be original record references; do not synthesize selectors, arguments, URLs, or actions.

tasks.objective: Select only from compact offered landing-page candidates and determine whether the initial page blocks search; do not consume the whole observation snapshot.

value.text: Using only compactPages, set blocked=true if an actually observed obstacle prevents searching, including CAPTCHA/access denial/unavailable page or no usable offered search input. Do not treat a cookie information link alone as a blocker. If not blocked, select exactly one offeredSearchInputId, preserving its original ID; do not create selectors or references.

tasks.objective: Only if the landing page is not blocked, reconnect the selected original search-input record, submit the single public query, observe results, select product records, and visit each selected product.
Lookup the selected search-input candidate IDs against original landing-page records to obtain the authoritative reference and action data.
Fill and submit the selected original Amazon.fr search input using the sole public query input.
Fill the observed Amazon search field with query and submit without interacting with cookie controls.
Read the submitted Amazon.fr search results as a bounded complete observation, preserving original product link records and metadata.
Project each bounded complete search-result page to its original records array for one-level flattening and lookup.
Flatten the search-result records exactly one level, retaining original ordering and records for product-link lookup.

Create compact per-page search-result views containing only immediate blockage facts and offered product-link candidate IDs in observed order; do not apply sponsored/organic filtering or deduplication.

value.text: For each search-result page, return only compact facts: any actually blocking obstacle and the offered product-detail link candidate IDs in their first observed page order. Candidate IDs must be original record references whose original records contain the authoritative href/action data. Do not exclude sponsored results, do not deduplicate, do not sample optional candidates, and do not invent eligibility criteria.

tasks.objective: Select up to the first 10 product-link candidate IDs from compact search observations, preserving observed order and repeated selections; detect real blockers truthfully.

value.text: Using only compactPages, set blocked=true only for an actually observed obstacle preventing product collection. If not blocked, select at most the first 10 offeredProductLinkIds in observed order. Preserve repeats if they were selected from the offered observations. Do not deduplicate, do not exclude sponsored products, and do not synthesize URLs or selectors.

tasks.objective: If search results are not blocked, lookup original product records and visit each selected product page; otherwise expose the observed blockage without publishing a workbook.
Lookup selected product IDs against the original search-result records so visits use authoritative observed href values.
Visit every selected original product record, up to 10 total, sequentially and produce one non-null typed row object per actually visited product.
Open one Amazon.fr product detail page using the authoritative href from the original selected product record.
Project each bounded complete product-detail observation page to records for compact extraction; fail on incomplete capture rather than fabricate a row.
Flatten product-detail page records exactly one level for local compact product extraction.
Create compact product-detail page views with explicit observed field candidates and blocker/missing-data facts only.

value.text: For each product-detail page, produce only compact observed facts and candidates needed to form the row: possible product names, descriptions or feature bullets, prices, and explicit conditions such as CAPTCHA, access denial, unavailable product, absent price, or absent data. Keep null when absent; never invent values.

tasks.objective: Return exactly one non-null typed row object for the actually visited product, with nullable fields for missing observed values and explicit status for CAPTCHA, absent price, or absent data.

value.text: Using only compact product-detail views, create one row object. name, description, and price are nullable and must contain only observed values. If CAPTCHA, access denial, unavailable page, missing price, or missing data is observed, keep affected fields null and explain explicitly in status. Do not invent a fallback row, product name, URL, or price.

tasks.objective: Copy the typed product row by direct binding for the outer foreach collection.
Expose non-blocked product rows by direct binding, preserving row order and max 10 cardinality from the product visit loop.
Expose the actually observed search-result blockage and no rows; workbook publication is guarded from this blocked path.
Expose the actually observed landing-page blockage or missing usable search input; workbook publication is guarded from this blocked path.
Require the workflow to be non-blocked before workbook rendering and publication; blocked paths stop truthfully without writing a workbook.
Render up to ten successfully visited product rows to tab-separated workbook content, preserving exact observed values and ordering.

value.text: Create TSV content for an Excel workbook. First row headers must be: name, description, price, status. Emit one row per product row in the supplied order, at most ten rows. Preserve observed values exactly except normalize tabs and line breaks inside cells. Nullable missing values remain empty cells, with any explicit missing/CAPTCHA/access status in the status cell. Do not add any synthetic blocked row.

tasks.objective: Save the extracted Amazon product rows as an Excel workbook at the required relative workspace path before browser cleanup.

always.objective: Close the browser page and context even if any earlier step fails.
